rules.adjacency: Orthogonal 4-neighbour on (x,y) grid; a node is selectable iff a neighbour is the start node or already selected. Deselecting must not orphan selected nodes. Source: aion2t.com planner JS logic (x() and removal BFS). Not confirmed in-game.
rules.start_node: Centre of each grid; free, cost 0, not selectable.

reset_cost.confidence: low: one-line patch note, Global unverified

rules.skill_level_note: Daevanion adds up to +4 skill levels per prior notes; per-board grant above is sum of skill nodes.

point_sources.detail: 2 Daevanion Crystals per clear; 61 per faction map = 122 points per full clear

currency_note.text: Metaroad (2026-10-03) says Nezekan..Triniel draw on DaevanionCrystal (570 of 840 asked) and Azphel on BattleCrystal (232 of 232); the Sorcerer file called all of it one pool.

rarity_note: Metaroad legend lists a Legend rarity next to Common/Rare/Epic/Unique; no Spiritmaster node uses grade 5 in the aion2t data, so cost_by_rarity is unchanged.

global_vs_korea.note: aion2t.com claims each class has 8 boards (Ariel, Azphel, Marchutan, Yustiel at level 45) but its Spiritmaster API returns 5 (display_order 5 absent). A search summary lists Ariel at 45 too. Unresolved whether extra boards exist/are KR-only.
global_vs_korea.data_region: aion2t.com says data from official NCSOFT API (likely Korea); metaroad shows same 5 boards. Global launch 2026-10-05 not yet verified.

shared_with_sorcerer.note: True means same grid cells, rarities and node types as daevanion_sorcerer.json; only stat/skill contents differ.
shared_with_sorcerer.conclusion: Board geometry, rarities, costs and every stat node match the Sorcerer boards cell for cell; only the skill nodes (and their skill ids) differ. A planner can share one stat layout per class and swap in the skill-node table.

discrepancies.detail: node sums here: PvP Defense 720, PvP Crit Resist 120, PvP Evasion 72; Metaroad page total shows 480 / 80 / 48 (exactly 2/3). Sorcerer file has the same 720/120/72. Cause unknown (Metaroad may skip a node group).
node sum includes Penetration +10 that Metaroad total omits.
